CustomField.description: 18 Sep 2026: the functions picked in the multi-select Benefitting Group column (the column the quote line editor shows on multi-year rows), as text - e.g. "Legal and Compliance functions". Blank when only "Other" or countries are picked, because those do not say who is covered. Read by License_Model_Display__c and Order_Form_BG_Undefined__c.
CustomField.formula: MID(IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "Legal"), " and Legal", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "Compliance"), " and Compliance", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "HR"), " and HR", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "Finance"), " and Finance", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "Procurement"), " and Procurement", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "Data Privacy"), " and Data Privacy", "") & IF(INCLUDES(Benefitting_Group2__c, "ESG"), " and ESG", ""), 6, 200)
CustomField.label: Order Form: group functions
